text: Given a mocked Cork GET /clients response, when cork_get_clients is called, then each client's warranty_status and latest_cyber_score are returned unchanged from the mock payload

expect: The warranty/coverage status, package name, and coverage dates returned by the tools match the Cork portal UI for the same client

text: Given a mocked Cork GET /clients/{client_uuid}/score-history response, when cork_get_client_score_history is called with that client_uuid, then the entries are returned in the same newest-first order the mock provided, unreordered

Given a mocked Cork GET /compliance/client/{client_uuid}/events response, when cork_get_compliance_events is called with that client_uuid, then each event's event_type, at_risk, and resolved fields are returned unchanged from the mock

Given a mocked Cork GET /vulnerabilities/software response, when cork_get_software_vulnerabilities is called, then each CVE's cvss_score, epss_score, and known_exploited flag are returned unchanged from the mock
Given the mocked Cork API returns HTTP 401 for any endpoint, when any of the 6 tools is called, then it returns a structured {error: {code: unauthorized}} response and raises no exception
Given the X-Cork-Api-Key header is absent entirely, when any of the 6 tools is called, then it returns {error: {code: not_configured}} without attempting an outbound call to Cork

Given no client_uuid argument is supplied, when cork_get_warranties, cork_get_client_score_history, or cork_get_compliance_events is called, then each returns {error: {code: invalid_argument}} and the Cork API mock is never called

Given a mocked empty-array response from /warranties, /compliance/client/{id}/events, or /vulnerabilities/software, when the corresponding tool is called, then it returns an empty list, not an error object

Given page_size=500 is requested, when any list-returning tool is called, then the value is clamped to the documented cap (200) before the Cork call is made, and a mocked has_more: true is surfaced unchanged in the tool output
